subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the actual and target revenue (in crores) of an industry in five different branches. Study the graph and answer the question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/210cfc6981ec99fea1716fe1289eda139eafe61f447b9b727ec22f3d354521a3.png] 

The ratio of actual revenue to the target revenue over all the branches is :
solution:
**Given:**

Actual and target revenue (in crores) of an industry in five different branches.

**Solution:**

Sum of all the actual revenue over all the branches is = 20 + 25 + 30 + 45 + 40 = 160

Sum of all the actual target over all the branches is = 15 + 30 + 30 + 35 + 60 = 170

Now, the ratio of actual revenue to the target revenue over all the branches = frac {160}{170} = frac {16}{17}.
